name: Prehistoric Prism

angles.text: As a dwarf, recovering genuine titan relics speaks to your people's search for their makers' origins and the Explorers' League's purpose.
As an Alliance member, your discovery enriches the scholarly collections in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers.

faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar asks you to carry the relic to Ironforge after authenticating the titan-like inscriptions on its facets in the Wetlands.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Prehistoric Prism?

aliases: who to turn in prehistoric prism
where to turn in prehistoric prism
faq.answer: You deliver the relic to High Explorer Magellas in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge, and he accepts it for the museum's collection.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the Prehistoric Prism?

faq.answer: The relic is an ancient, multifaceted artifact bearing the unmistakable marks of the keepers. Light passing through its crystalline form recalls relics found in Uldaman.
faq.q: What kind of artifact is the Prehistoric Prism?

faq.answer: The Explorers' League collects and catalogs authentic relics of titan origin. High Explorer Magellas studies artifacts like this to deepen understanding of ancient history.
faq.q: Why is the Hall of Explorers interested in the prism?

aliases: does uldaman relate to the prism
faq.answer: High Explorer Magellas compares the light refracted through the artifact to relics he examined on his first archaeological dig in Uldaman, noting its keeper markings.
faq.q: How does the prism relate to Uldaman?

faq.answer: Prospector Whelgar's authentication and your recovery of the relic are to be recorded in the Explorers' League's historical archives.
faq.q: Does your name get recorded in the museum's catalogue?

sections.body: Prospector Whelgar finds a remarkable artifact while surveying the Wetlands. Intricate keeper inscriptions cover its many facets, and Whelgar authenticates the titan-like markings. He urges you to carry the relic to Ironforge, where scholars can study it. Whelgar hopes the discovery will enter the official catalogue, with both your recovery and his authentication properly credited.
sections.title: An Ancient Discovery

sections.body: High Explorer Magellas receives the relic for the Explorers' League in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Its maker marks confirm its authenticity. Magellas says the light passing through its polished facets recalls wonders he saw on his first excavation in Uldaman. Your donation preserves the artifact for study and adds to the League's records of the titans' legacy.
sections.title: A Gift to the Museum

summary: In the Wetlands, Prospector Whelgar finds a relic marked by the keepers. He sends you with it to Ironforge, where the Explorers' League can study the titans' legacy.
